kind: analyze (structural characterization of a relaxed dislocation dipole: row census, cores and tip chemistry, region spacings, closest core-shell contact, polar axis)
provenance: Our own analysis of the staged deposited x-poled field-free cell (3_reproduction/L8/structures/cell_a.lmp, the rewritten deposit; decision record 2026-09-05 condition (3): the L3 analyze unit stages a deposited cell and our analysis of it is the ground truth), computed by reviewer/make_reference_submission.py on 2026-09-06 with the L8 leaf's reader and census (local_dipoles.py). Cross-checks: the census and tip labels equal 3_reproduction/L3 review section 6 and L8 geometry.json; the shortest Ti-core/O-shell contact 1.589 A equals the L3 structure audit (section 5, 'xpoled 1.589 A'). The core midpoint and its dependent separation/contact distance were corrected using the original file coordinates; this is post-processing of the same staged cell, not a new reproduction.

core_BaO_xy_A.rule: each coordinate within 4.0 A (identification band, handbook 2(5) exception)

core_separation_over_Ly.rule: +/-10 percent relative (rule 2(1)); the leaf record's row-midpoint core rule gives 0.4970, inside

ba_spacing_x_region_A_A.rule: absolute 0.02 A (documented exception: the two regions differ by 2.5 percent, so the 10 percent band could not tell them apart; the quantity is Lx/39 exactly under periodic rows)

min_Ti_core_O_shell_A.rule: +/-5 percent relative (documented exception to the 10 percent rule: the value is deterministic on the staged file, and the nearest wrong reading, the Ti-core/O-core minimum 1.7463 A, is 9.9 percent away; the ideal Ti-O bond 2.0 A is far outside)

min_contact_nearest_core.rule: exact string after the same global naming mapping as both core coordinates

min_contact_distance_to_core_A.rule: absolute 3.0 A (the leaf record's core rule puts the same Ti 7.05 A from the core; documented exception, an identification band)

Ti_shell_displacement_mean_A.rule: x within +/-10 percent relative and the sign exact; y and z within 0.01 A absolute (zero-target floor)

score: 1 only if every primary check passes under identity or one coherent global BaO/TiO2 permutation (binary all-primary-pass)

reference_builder.scope: Repository-only provenance tool; not executable from a standalone review kit. grader.py and selfcheck.py do not import it.
dependencies: staged inputs and reproduction result records
reference_builder.core_definition: Periodic Cartesian midpoint of actual Ba gap endpoints in the outermost region-A row; output in original data-file coordinates. Dependent geometry recomputed.

core_naming_equivalence.accepted: identity or one global BaO/TiO2 permutation
core_naming_equivalence.rationale: The prompt allows naming the surviving termination or the inferred removed-material termination. All name-dependent fields must use one convention consistently. Canonical numerical truth and every numerical tolerance are unchanged.
